tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground (site, docs, cover). / Fond de page.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Comment cards, composer, code blocks. / Cartes de commentaire, zone de rédaction, blocs de code.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Side panel and sidebars, behind paper-raised cards. / Panneau latéral, sous les cartes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: rules between sections, card outlines. Not for control borders (below 3:1). / Filets décoratifs uniquement.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and secondary buttons; at least 3:1 on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk in both themes. / Bordures des contrôles.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and rubric-soft. Also the bracket of the mark. / Texte courant et titres.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Dates, quoted passages in cards, captions, placeholders; on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and rubric-soft (5:1 or more). / Dates, citations, légendes.

tokens.name: rubric
tokens.usage: The accent, used sparingly: the dot of the mark, the primary button, links, the focus ring. As text on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk (5.3:1 or more). / L'accent, avec parcimonie.

tokens.name: rubric-soft
tokens.usage: Flash after jumping to a passage, selected state of a quiet button, tinted callouts. Text on it: ink or rubric. / Fond teinté.

tokens.name: on-rubric
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a rubric fill (primary button). Dark text in the night theme, because rubric lightens there. / Texte sur fond rubric.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. 5.3:1 or more on every surface in both themes. / Anneau de focus.

tokens.name: cat-idee
tokens.usage: Category 'Idée / Idea'. The plugin's real default category colour (src/settings.ts). Marks only: underline, 12% tint, chip dot, card edge. 3:1 on paper, 2.7:1 on paper-sunk (flagged: do not use it as a lone signal there). Never as text. / Catégorie par défaut du plugin.

tokens.name: cat-question
tokens.usage: Proposed category 'Question'. Marks only; 3.3:1 or more on every surface in both themes. One hex for both themes because the plugin stores a single colour per category. / Catégorie proposée.

tokens.name: cat-verifier
tokens.usage: Proposed category 'À vérifier / To verify'. Marks only; 3.3:1 or more on every surface in both themes. / Catégorie proposée.

tokens.name: cat-citation
tokens.usage: Proposed category 'Citation / Quote'. Marks only; 3.4:1 or more on every surface in both themes. / Catégorie proposée.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero line of the site. / Une par page.

styles.name: title

styles.usage: Page and article titles. / Titres de page.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Lire le crayon à la main

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Sub-sections, card titles on the site. / Sous-sections.

styles.name: reading

styles.usage: Long-form text: articles, the demo note, docs prose. Max line length measure-reading. / Texte long.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Comments are stored as plain text inside the note itself.
styles.usage: Default prose on the site and in this brand book. / Texte courant.

styles.name: quote

styles.usage: The quoted passage at the top of a comment card, in ink-muted. / Passage cité.

styles.name: ui
styles.usage: Comment text in cards, inputs, menus. / Texte d'interface.

styles.name: ui-strong
styles.usage: Panel title, button labels, selected chip. / Libellés forts.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Storage format, regex, file paths, commands. / Format de stockage, chemins.

tokens.name: space-4

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks inside a section; cover insets. / Entre blocs.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop. / Gouttière bureau.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections. / Entre sections.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Above page titles, around the hero. / Autour du titre principal.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Commented passage tint (as in styles.css). / Teinte du passage commenté.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, inputs, comment cards, code blocks. / Boutons, cartes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Larger panels and screenshots on the site. / Panneaux, captures.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App icon tile only. / Tuile de l'icône.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Category dots. / Pastilles de couleur.
